title: Rank-two quadratic tangent obstruction to third-order deformations of the trivial SL2 complex character of a finitely generated group
source_title: The parallelogram identity on groups and deformations of the trivial character in $\protect \mathrm{SL}_2(\protect \mathbb{C})$
author: Julien Marché; Maxime Wolff
difficulty_reason: A noncommutative fourth-augmentation identity forces the cubic part of a parallelogram tangent to vanish at second order. Two distinct sixth-augmentation expansions at third order yield all three-by-three Gram minors, imposing rank at most two on the induced quadratic tangent form.
